## Notes

Tuxedo Labs (Dennis Gustafsson); early access 2020-10-29; full release 2022-04-21; PS5 and Xbox Series 2023; fully destructible voxel levels; alarm starts 60-second getaway timer; fire spread; ray-traced lighting; Lua scripting and Workshop; co-op multiplayer update 2026-03-12.
